title: Parse duration strings like 1h30m into milliseconds

brief.goal: Add `parseDuration(text)` to src/duration.ts accepting units ms, s, m, h in any combination without spaces (e.g. "1h30m", "45s", "500ms") and returning milliseconds; invalid or empty input throws an Error.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test

files.src/duration.ts: export const UNITS_MS = { ms: 1, s: 1000, m: 60_000, h: 3_600_000 } as const;

expected_clean_output: Token-based parser with strict full-consumption check; grader passes.

seeded_defect.description: Minutes are multiplied by 60 instead of 60000, so "1h30m" is 3601800 ms.
